_comment: Curated seed for the occultation pages. Each entry is (object, date, audience) and nothing else — every number on a page is computed from DE431 by api/lookup/generate/occultation_event.py. Candidates come from a DE431 scan (see that script's --scan), never from a published table. `audience` picks the city list, the map framing and the display timezone.

events.note: Daylight occultation of Śukra by a three-day crescent; the north limit runs across north India — Delhi misses, Mumbai gets an hour.
